notes: Of-record matrix for the RAG paper (plan of 2026-09-26). Condition ids match the paper: C0, C1, C2a/b/c, C3.

C2b (reranker) is implemented (needs sentence-transformers; model BAAI/bge-reranker-base or AGENTIGRID_RERANKER_MODEL). Its thresholds must be fixed from labeled pairs and added to the C2b env as AGENTIGRID_CRAG_TAU_LOWER / _UPPER before the of-record run; until then C2b uses the cosine defaults 0.30/0.50 on reranker scores (pilot only). C2c (reranker_calibrated) and C3 (graph) are not implemented yet; the runner refuses them unless --skip-unimplemented is passed.
C2c is gated: run it only if C2b beats C2a (paper H4).
case39 carries the economic goals only (no contingency file ships with ExaGO for case39).

Pre-check 2026-09-26 (after patch 0010; before it, AgentiGrid-rewritten ACTIVSg cases lost genfuel and SCOPFLOW failed): on ACTIVSg200 with the shipped contingency file, SCOPFLOW is feasible wherever OPFLOW is (both through x1.6, both fail from x1.7), and the security premium is 0 through x1.3, 0.15% at x1.4, 0.34% at x1.5, 0.64% at x1.6. A 'find the N-1-secure dispatch' goal is attained by the baseline SCOPFLOW solve at every load, so it is replaced by n1cost10 on a frozen x1.5 variant.

Localized goals run on PFLOW because OPFLOW enforces line ratings and the voltage band as hard constraints. relieve uses the frozen x1.3 variant (PFLOW: 4 overloads, max loading 114.4%; OPFLOW feasible, so a fix exists). voltage is pending: with the case's own band no scale up to x1.5 violates; a 0.95-1.05 pu band variant is being pre-checked.

Frozen variants live in rag/tools/specs/cases/ (data/ is git-ignored); written by precheck_cases.py --write-stressed with the fixed MATPOWER writer. N-1 uses the ExaGO-shipped contingency file with all contingencies (AgentiGrid passes -scopflow_Nc -1); keep exago.mpi_np = 1 (mpi_np > 1 selects EMPAR, which the evaluator rejects).

Goal attainment: cost10 by target_pct; n1cost10 by n1_secure (feasible SCOPFLOW solve with -ctgcfile, -scopflow_Nc -1 and a coupled solver) AND target_pct on the same entry; relieve/voltage by no_violations; loadmax has no attainment predicate. Cost targets are guarded: a reduction does not count when total load is below baseline (0.1% tolerance) or a set_cost_coeffs command is in effect; cost_improvement_pct obeys the same guard and cost_guard_rejections counts rejected entries. A cell whose baseline already attains its goal (baseline_attained=1) measures nothing and must be fixed before analysis.
Run from the agentigrid project root with the venv active and OLLAMA_HOST set.
